info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Loan Application API
info.description: The Update Loan Application API allows users to modify existing loan application details. This endpoint is crucial for financial institutions and lending agencies aiming to keep application data current, whether through customer updates or internal processing adjustments. Typical consumers include loan officers and customer service representatives who require real-time access to application data modifications. By facilitating updates efficiently, the API enhances workflow and operational productivity within the lending process.

patch.description: This endpoint allows developers to update the details of a specific loan application identified by its unique identifier. It requires the relevant fields to be included in the request body to execute the update successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body updates the loan application with the specified ID. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the defined schema for successful processing.
